verification.validation: Hyper Backup application backup streams SQLite in place and honours backup.exclude. appbackup Go tests, go build and go vet on a Linux runner, sdk-version, executor manifest and documentation version checks, and an internal-content scan of the packed npm tarballs. npm packages packed from this commit. No full gate, target matrix, executor rebuild, Rust build, crate publication or NAS acceptance.

changes: Online application backup streams each SQLite database into the archive in place under a sqlite3 read transaction instead of copying it; a WAL database copies only its WAL, re-copied if a writer restarted it, and writers keep committing. Writers of a rollback-journal database wait until its file has been read.
backup.exclude (appbackup.Config.Exclude) lists glob patterns of data-folder files and folders left out of the archive. Apps that declare it need CLI 0.53.13 or later.
